force_information: Forward gate receives only cached SOURCE physical even force. Reverse gate receives the candidate force only after its paid query. No gradients through force/coordinate inputs are required for gate fitting.
linear_features: Previous four cheap physical/proposal features plus physical even-force dot COM displacement divided by kT. Work control uses this force term, exact COM restraint difference and complete known proposal ratio. Fixed physical control reproduces the preceding screen.
neural: Two-layer invariant paired-source/candidate geometry graph encoder with role embeddings and atomwise source-force work/norm/displacement features. Zero output initialization; no earlier checkpoint loaded.
objective: Fixed recorded whole-prefix utility minus FIT whole-prefix baseline rate times expected cost; normalize by baseline128 calls. Initial and nonjoint contributions remain fixed. Uniform1/72 weight per FIT trajectory, not per joint attempt; regularizer averages squared forward/reverse log gates across all FIT attempts. Both gates enter utility; only forward gate enters query cost.
edge_sampling: Both recipes use identical FIT-only activity-stratified index probabilities and same random draws per seed/variant for every step. Teacher contributions use exact uniform-attempt index correction; utility contributions use exact whole-prefix weights. All failures retained.
thinning_control: One constant passing probability per learned model, calibrated from its FIT expected joint-query fraction, evaluated with ordinary corrected MH. No selection outcome sets this probability.
validation: All12 internal selection parents and their24 recorded prefixes. Report whole-prefix and conditional joint rates, raw work/cost, joint acceptance and constitutional flow. These are fixed-source expectations, not changed chains or achieved savings.
protected: Only36 FIT parents enter optimization; no internal-selection or fresh-follow-up outcomes, prior molecular evaluation cohorts or722 reserved outcomes enter fitting.
final_checkpoint: Fixed800 for both recipes and seeds, all controls unchanged.
stages: Direct: utility at all800 steps. Distill: normalized squared forward/reverse oracle log-gate errors for500 steps, then the same utility objective for300 steps. Adam is reset at step500 for BOTH recipes; no intermediate validation or checkpoint selection.
teacher_objective: Mean across all FIT attempts, with zero contribution for unsupported attempts, of [(log_gf-log_gf_star)^2+(log_gr-log_gr_star)^2]/(2 B^2). Oracle targets clamp the fixed true MH log ratio and its negative into[-B,0]. Target energy is a training label, never a model input.
phase_boundary_checkpoint: Saved at500 for audit only; all comparisons use the fixed800-step model. No validation at the boundary.
audit: Replay all final controls/model metrics, both gates on all1597 scored pairs, final utility gradients and the actual phase-boundary objective gradients for every active head. Preserve eight independent arms and all negative results.
scope: Matched8-arm offline comparison; same architectures/data/total steps. No actual chain or saved-query claim from the fixed-source whole-prefix proxy.
